chapter.verse: Khris' min tawh thumaan thutak kong genin ah—zuauphuak hilo, keima' kitheihtawmna lungsim in Kha Siangtho tawh teci a pan thu pen—
ka lungsim sungtawng ah nakpi dahna leh tatsatlo lunggimna ka nei hi.
Ka sanggamte ahi cilesa lam pan ka mipihte' ading ahih nakleh keimahmah haamsiat tuakin Khris tawh kikhen ding ciangdong ka lunggulh ngam hi.
Tuate pen Israel mite ahi uh hi. Ta suahsakna, minpha, thuciamte, thukhun kipiakna, biakpiakna, kamciamte, cihte pen amaute' neih ahi hi.
Pupite zong amaute' a hi a, Khris zong cilesa lam panin amaute' sungpan hong piang hi. Tua Khris pen nate khempeuh tunga om, a tawntunga phatna a ngah Pasian ahi hi. Amen.
Tua ka cih ciangin Pasian' thu muibun lo cihna lam hilo hi. A hang pen Israel sungpana piangte a vekun Israel hi kimlo,
Abraham' tate zong a vekun Abraham' suanlekhak hi kimlo uh a, “Isaac tungtawnin nangma' suanlekhak cih min kilo ding hi,” cih bek om hi.
Hih pen Pasian' tate cih ciangin cilesa pana piang tate hilo-in kamciamna pana piang tate bek suanlekhak kici, cihna ahi hi.
A hang pen, “A kiseh hun a tun ciangin kong paikik ding a, Sarah in tapa khat nei ding hi,” ci-in kamciam om hi.
Tua bek hilo a, Rebekah in mi khat ahi, i pupi Isaac tungtawnin nau a paai lai-in
tua naute a suah ma, a sia a pha bangmah a bawl theih ma-un—gamtatna hang hilo, hong sampa' deihna hangin teelkhiatna vai Pasian' ngimna a kizop theih nadingin—
“A uzaw pen a nauzaw' sila suak ding hi,” ci-in ama' kiangah kigen hi.
“Jacob ka thupilak a, Esau ka nolh hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bang ahi hi.
Tua ahihleh i bangci gen ding hiam? Pasian' lampan diklohna om ahi hiam? Hi peuhmah lo hi!
A hang pen Pasian in Moses' kiangah, “Ka khualte ka khual ding a, ka lainatte ka lainat ding hi,” ci hi.
Tua hi a, hih thu pen mihing' deihzawh thu leh sepzawh thu hilo-in thukhualna a nei Pasian' tungah a kinga ahi hi.

A hang pen Pasian' Laibu in Pharaoh Kumpi' kiangah, “Nang' tungtawnin ka vangliatna ka lah theih nading leh leitung mun citeng ah ka min a kitangko theih nading, cih hih ngimna hang mah tawh nang hong tawisang ka hi hi,” ci hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian in ama' ut peuh khualin ama' ut peuh lungkhauhsak hi.
“Tua bang ahihleh bang hangin Pasian in hong mawhsak lai veve ahi hiam? Amah' deihna kua in langdo zo ding ahi hiam?” nong ci ding uh hi.
Ahi zongin mihing aw, Pasian a nial dingin nang kua na hi hiam? A kibawlsa na in a bawlpa' kiangah, “Bang hangin hih bangin hong bawl na hi hiam?” ci ding ahi hiam?
Beelseekpa in tungman lom khat veve sungpan thupizat beel leh nautangzat beel bawl theih nading thu nei hilo ahi hiam?

Ahih hangin Pasian in ama' hehna lahkhiat ding leh ama' vangliatna a kitheih ding a deihna hangin kisiatna hun' adinga kikoihkhol hehna beelte lungduaina lianpi tawh hong thuak ahihleh bang gen ding om lai ahi hiam?
Tua pen minpha ngah dingin a koihkholhsa thukhualna beelte' adinga om ama' minpha a kicinzia a kitheih ding a utna ahi hi.
Tua ngimna tawh hong sapsa ahi eite pen Jew mite sungpan bek hilo-in Gentile mite sungpan zong i kihel hi.
Hosea Laibu sungah zong hih bangin na gen hi: “Keima' mi ahilote ‘ka mite,’ ka ci ding a, a ki-itlo nu zong ‘it aw,’ ka ci ding hi.”
“Tua ciangin, ‘Keima' mi na hikei uh hi,’ a kicihna mun teekteek mah ah amaute pen ‘a nungta Pasian' tate,’ kici ding uh hi.”
Isaiah in zong Israel mite' thu a genna ah, “Israel' tate a phazah pen tuipi sehnel bang ahih hangin a omlai tawmno khat bek in hotkhiat ngah ding hi.
A hang pen Topa in leitung ah ama' thu a cingtakin leh nawhsa thu-in hong semkhia ding hi,” ci-in kiko hi.
A nuai-a Isaiah' genkholh bang lian i hi hi: “Vanglian Topa in eite' tungah suanlekhak hong nusiat lo hileh Sodom bang i hi khinta ding a, Gomorrah tawh i kibang ding hi.”
Tua ahihleh bang i gen lai ding hiam? Dikna thu a sulzuihlo Gentile mite in tua dikna—upna tawh kingah diksakna—ngahkha khin uh a,
dikna thukhun a sulzuih Israel mite in tua thukhun ngahkha lo uh hi.
Bang hang ahi hiam? A hang pen sepzawh thu tawh a kingah ding bang khatin upna suang lo uh hi. Palkhaktheih suang palkha-in tuk uh a,
tua pen a kigelhsa bang lian ahi hi: “En un, Zion ah palkhaktheih suangtum khat leh puktheihna suangpi khat ka koih a, amah a um peuhpeuh maizumna tuakkha lo ding uh hi.”
